## Details
### **SW-REQ-TELEM-001** — Build Telemetry Packet From Inputs

- **Description:** The telemetry library shall build a telemetry packet from caller-provided input fields on each call.
- **Rationale:** telem_lib is the packet builder consumed by the telemetry app at the SYS-019 2 Hz cadence.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-003
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-TELEM-002** — Serialize Packet Into Caller Buffer

- **Description:** The telemetry library shall serialize each packet into a caller-provided byte buffer.
- **Rationale:** Caller-owned memory pattern; telem_lib performs no allocation and writes only to injected storage.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-050
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-TELEM-003** — Packet Content Coverage

- **Description:** The telemetry library shall include timestamp, phase, GPS fix, baro altitude, nav state, voltage, validity, and health.
- **Rationale:** Mirrors SYS-020 packet content so ground monitoring sees full mission state.
- **Verification Method:** Inspection
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-020
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-TELEM-004** — Bounded Packet Size

- **Description:** The telemetry library shall produce packets whose serialized size does not exceed the configured maximum.
- **Rationale:** RYLR896 LoRa MTU bounds payload size; lora_lib must accept what telem_lib produces.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-003
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-TELEM-005** — Integrity Field In Packet

- **Description:** The telemetry library shall append an integrity check field covering the packet contents.
- **Rationale:** Ground station decoder must validate packets against corruption over the LoRa link.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-003
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-TELEM-006** — Phase-Independent Packet Production

- **Description:** The telemetry library shall produce a packet on every call regardless of flight phase.
- **Rationale:** SYS-021 mandates continuous coverage; telem_lib must not gate output on phase state.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-021
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-TELEM-007** — Embed Sensor Health Bitmap

- **Description:** The telemetry library shall embed the caller-provided sensor health bitmap in each packet.
- **Rationale:** SYS-031 requires continuous health observability via every telemetry packet.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-031
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-TELEM-008** — Embed Monotonic Microsecond Timestamp

- **Description:** The telemetry library shall embed the caller-provided monotonic microsecond timestamp in each packet.
- **Rationale:** SYS-026 mandates the monotonic time base on every record, including downlinked packets.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-026
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-TELEM-009** — Deterministic Serialization

- **Description:** The telemetry library shall produce identical byte output for identical input fields.
- **Rationale:** SYS-044 determinism enables Trick regression and ground decoder consistency.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-044
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-TELEM-010** — POSIX And Pico2 Equivalent Output

- **Description:** The telemetry library shall produce identical serialized bytes on POSIX and Pico2 builds for identical inputs.
- **Rationale:** SYS-043 functional equivalence so Trick simulation exercises the flight-side wire format.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-043
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-TELEM-011** — No Radio Or UART I/O

- **Description:** The telemetry library shall not perform any UART or radio input or output operations.
- **Rationale:** Pure encoder scope; transmission belongs to lora_lib, preserving separation of concerns.
- **Verification Method:** Inspection
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-003
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-TELEM-012** — Embed Navigation Validity Flag

- **Description:** The telemetry library shall embed the caller-provided navigation validity flag in each packet.
- **Rationale:** SYS-020 packet content includes validity so ground consumers can gate use of nav fields.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-020
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1
